name: Madou Reito
source: Childhood friend of Hinomori Hina. Reito is willing to anything means necessary to achieve his ambitions. [Spoiler] He is the son of the Demon King, his mother was raped by the Demon King. His real name is Asfard Dormalate the prince of the lost kingdom Principality of Asphard. He despites the Demon King.[Spoiler]
